name: sql_auto_complete
description: Return ranked autocomplete suggestions for a partial SQL string using the VS-Code-derived fuzzy matcher. Used by the DuckDB CLI for Tab-completion; you can also call it directly in SQL. Returns the same five columns as the stock extension: `suggestion`, `suggestion_start`, `suggestion_type`, `suggestion_score` (0 for the best match, lower is better) and `extra_char`. With the [v1.5 activation fix](https://github.com/Query-farm/fuzzycomplete/commit/8b89b19bbed0c7338a2a5e1dfc08eea88290e0ee), loading fuzzycomplete replaces the preloaded stock provider. Older build `9746833` leaves the stock provider active when autocomplete is already loaded.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: The partial SQL text the user has typed. Suggestions are ranked by fuzzy match score against keywords and identifiers (databases, schemas, tables, columns) currently visible to the session. Positional only.

parameters.name: max_suggestion_count
parameters.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return (default 20). Accepted for compatibility with the stock autocomplete extension.

parameters.name: max_file_suggestion_count
parameters.description: Maximum number of file and directory suggestions to return. Accepted for compatibility with the stock autocomplete extension.

parameters.name: max_exact_suggestion_count
parameters.description: Accepted for compatibility with the stock autocomplete extension; has no effect, since fuzzy matching has no exact-only tail.

examples.description: Complete a SQL keyword — the top suggestion for `SEL` is `SELECT`.
Suggest a table name after `FROM` — the completer walks every attached database and schema in the search path.
Substring + camelCase matching — typing `gnst` finds `getNotificationStatus` even though it isn't a prefix.
examples.code:
SELECT suggestion
FROM sql_auto_complete('SELECT * FROM gnst');
